description: Synthetic evaluation dataset containing operational procedural queries, ground-truth matching procedure chunks, non-operational distractor chunks, borderline negative controls, and superseded procedure traps.

corpus.text: RAPID DEPRESSURIZATION AND EMERGENCY DESCENT MEMORY ACTIONS: 1. Oxygen Masks - ON/100%. 2. Crew Communications - Establish. 3. Altitude - Set 10,000 ft or MEA. 4. Thrust Levers - Idle. 5. Speedbrake - Flight Detent. 6. Target Airspeed - Maximum structural cruising speed Vmo/Mmo.

ENGINE FAILURE AFTER V1: 1. Directional Control - Maintain with rudder pedals. 2. Rotation - Rotate smoothly at Vr toward 10 to 12 degrees pitch. 3. Target Speed - Maintain V2 until obstacle clearance altitude. 4. Landing Gear - UP after positive rate of climb verified. Do not secure engine switches below 400 feet AGL.

STERILE FLIGHT DECK REGULATION: Flight crew members shall not engage in non-essential conversation, paperwork, or extraneous activities below 10,000 feet MSL, during taxi operations, takeoff, approach, and landing phases. All flight deck communication must strictly pertain to aircraft operation and safety.

GO-AROUND AND MISSED APPROACH: 1. Pilot Flying calls 'GO-AROUND, FLAPS 15', simultaneously presses TO/GA switches and advances thrust levers to go-around thrust. 2. Rotate to go-around pitch attitude (approx 15 degrees nose up). 3. Pilot Monitoring verifies go-around thrust and calls 'THRUST SET'. 4. When positive climb verified, PF calls 'GEAR UP'.

CONTAMINATED RUNWAY TAKEOFF PERFORMANCE (SUPERSEDED REV 1.2): Use dry snow friction coefficient 0.20 and maximum crosswind limit 15 knots. Reverse thrust credit is permitted for stopping distance calculation under winter conditions.

CONTAMINATED RUNWAY TAKEOFF PERFORMANCE (CURRENT REV 2.0): MANDATORY UPDATE: In accordance with FAA SAFO 19001 and ICAO GRF, reverse thrust credit is STRICTLY PROHIBITED for contaminated runway takeoff distance dispatch calculations. Use updated Runway Condition Code (RWYCC 2) friction baseline 0.14.

metadata.documentTitle: Flight Crew Operations Manual: Winter Operations Directive

corpus.text: CABIN PASSENGER SAFETY DEMONSTRATION: In the unlikely event of a loss of cabin pressure, four oxygen masks will drop automatically from the overhead compartment above your seat. Pull the mask firmly toward you to start the flow of oxygen. Place the mask over your nose and mouth and breathe normally before assisting others.

MAINTENANCE GROUND ENGINE RUN-UP: Position aircraft on designated taxiway run-up pad facing directly into wind. Confirm wheel chocks installed and fire tender on standby. Advance N1 to 70% to check vibration harmonics before concluding maintenance engine functional test.

metadata.documentTitle: Aircraft Maintenance Manual: Engine Ground Test

corpus.text: IN-FLIGHT ENTERTAINMENT (IFE) STREAMING: Passengers may connect their personal smartphones, tablets, or laptops to the onboard Wi-Fi network 'SkyStream-Guest'. Access our library of Hollywood blockbuster movies, TV series, podcasts, and digital magazines free of charge in Economy and Business cabins.

PET TRAVEL IN CABIN: Domestic cats and dogs weighing under 8 kilograms including carrier are permitted in the passenger cabin. The pet carrier must fit securely under the seat in front of you (maximum dimensions 45 x 30 x 20 cm) and remain fully closed for the duration of the flight.

FREQUENT FLYER LOUNGE ACCESS: Gold and Platinum tier frequent flyer cardholders departing on international scheduled services may access the airport premium lounge with one accompanying guest. Complimentary refreshments, private showers, and quiet work cubicles are provided.

metadata.documentTitle: Frequent Flyer Program Benefits & Lounge Access

corpus.text: LOST BAGGAGE COMPENSATION POLICY: If checked baggage is delayed beyond 24 hours from arrival time, passengers may claim reimbursement for essential toiletries and clothing up to 150 USD per day. All claims must be lodged through our baggage portal within 21 days of flight arrival.
